name: Stunning Blast
body:
School evocation [force]; Level cleric/oracle 2, magus 2, sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25ft + 5ft/2 levels)
Effect one ray
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fort (partial); see text; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You blast your opponent with a ray of nonlethal force that may leave them disoriented. You fire a ray that requires a ranged touch attack to hit and deals 3d6 points of nonlethal damage. This is a force effect. A target struck by this ray must succeed a Fortitude save, or be stunned for 1 round.
